#!/bin/bash
set -e

# Colors
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Paths
MOJO_NOTES_DIR="$HOME/mojo-notes"
SKILL_NAME="mojo-notes"
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"

echo "正在安装 Mojo Notes..."
echo ""

# 1. Create ~/mojo-notes/ directory structure
if [ -d "$MOJO_NOTES_DIR" ]; then
    echo -e "${YELLOW}!${NC} 目录 $MOJO_NOTES_DIR 已存在，跳过创建"
else
    mkdir -p "$MOJO_NOTES_DIR"/{daily,research,notes}
    echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} 创建目录 $MOJO_NOTES_DIR/"
    echo "  ├── daily/"
    echo "  ├── research/"
    echo "  └── notes/"
fi

# 2. Copy skill to ~/mojo-notes/.claude-skill/mojo-notes/
SKILL_DEST="$MOJO_NOTES_DIR/.claude-skill/$SKILL_NAME"
mkdir -p "$SKILL_DEST/references"
cp "$SCRIPT_DIR/skill/SKILL.md" "$SKILL_DEST/"
cp "$SCRIPT_DIR/skill/install.sh" "$SKILL_DEST/"
chmod +x "$SKILL_DEST/install.sh"
if [ -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/skill/references/conventions.md" ]; then
    cp "$SCRIPT_DIR/skill/references/conventions.md" "$SKILL_DEST/references/"
fi
echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} 安装 skill 到 $SKILL_DEST/"

# 3. Write path config
CONFIG_DIR="$HOME/.config/mojo-notes"
mkdir -p "$CONFIG_DIR"
echo "$MOJO_NOTES_DIR" > "$CONFIG_DIR/path"
echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} 写入路径配置到 ~/.config/mojo-notes/path"

# 4. Create symlink to ~/.claude/skills/
mkdir -p "$HOME/.claude/skills"
ln -sfn "$SKILL_DEST" "$HOME/.claude/skills/$SKILL_NAME"
echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} 注册到 ~/.claude/skills/$SKILL_NAME"

# 5. Add zn command to ~/.zshrc
ZN_MARKER="# >>> mojo-notes zn command >>>"
if grep -q "$ZN_MARKER" "$HOME/.zshrc" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo -e "${YELLOW}!${NC} zn 命令已存在于 ~/.zshrc，跳过"
else
    cat >> "$HOME/.zshrc" << 'EOF'

# >>> mojo-notes zn command >>>
zn() {
    local subcmd=$1
    shift
    local model="haiku"
    [[ "$subcmd" == "research" ]] && model="opus"
    claude -p "使用 /mojo-notes skill 执行: $subcmd $*" --model "$model" --print
}

_zn() {
    _describe 'command' '(
        daily:记录每日事项
        todo:添加待办
        note:记录笔记
        research:创建研究话题
        search:搜索笔记
        list:列出条目
        remind:管理提醒
        commit:Git提交
    )'
}
(( $+functions[compdef] )) && compdef _zn zn || zicompdef _zn zn 2>/dev/null || true
# <<< mojo-notes zn command <<<
EOF
    echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} 添加 zn 命令到 ~/.zshrc"
fi

echo ""
echo -e "${GREEN}安装完成！${NC}"
echo ""
echo "运行 source ~/.zshrc 后即可使用："
echo ""
echo "  zn daily 今天的记录"
echo "  zn todo 待办事项"
echo "  zn search 关键词"
echo ""
echo -e "${YELLOW}建议使用 git 管理 ~/mojo-notes/ 目录。${NC}"

#!/bin/bash
set -e

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
NOTES_DIR="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
SKILL_NAME="mojo-notes"

# Write path config
CONFIG_DIR="$HOME/.config/mojo-notes"
mkdir -p "$CONFIG_DIR"
echo "$NOTES_DIR" > "$CONFIG_DIR/path"
echo "✓ 笔记路径已写入 ~/.config/mojo-notes/path"

# Create symlink
mkdir -p "$HOME/.claude/skills"
ln -sfn "$SCRIPT_DIR" "$HOME/.claude/skills/$SKILL_NAME"
echo "✓ 符号链接已创建 ~/.claude/skills/$SKILL_NAME -> $SCRIPT_DIR"

echo ""
echo "安装完成！"
echo "  笔记路径: $NOTES_DIR"
echo "  Skill 路径: ~/.claude/skills/$SKILL_NAME"
echo ""
echo "现在可以在 Claude Code 中使用 /$SKILL_NAME 命令。"

# Mojo Notes

AI 驱动的笔记工作流系统，由 Claude Code 提供支持。

## 快速开始

```bash
git clone https://github.com/xpzouying/mojo.git
cd mojo
./install.sh
source ~/.zshrc
```

## 使用方法

```bash
# 记录每日事项
zn daily 今天完成了 API 重构

# 添加待办
zn todo 明天提交季度报告

# 记录笔记
zn note API 设计思考

# 创建研究话题
zn research kubernetes-hpa

# 搜索笔记
zn search kubernetes

# 列出条目
zn list
zn list daily
zn list research

# 添加提醒
zn remind +3d 审核 PR
zn remind 2026-03-20 提交报告

# Git 提交
zn commit
```

## 安装后的目录结构

```
~/mojo-notes/
├── daily/           # 每日记录（按月份 YYYYMM.md 组织）
├── research/        # 研究主题
├── notes/           # 个人笔记
└── REMINDER.md      # 提醒事项
```

## 功能特点

- **命令行快捷方式**：无需进入 Claude Code 交互模式，直接在终端快速记录
- **AI 驱动**：Claude Code 自动理解意图，智能管理笔记
- **结构化存储**：按 daily/research/notes 分类，便于检索
- **Git 友好**：建议使用 git 管理笔记目录

## 命令说明

| 命令 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| `zn daily <内容>` | 记录每日事项 |
| `zn todo <内容>` | 添加待办事项 |
| `zn note <内容>` | 创建个人笔记 |
| `zn research <主题>` | 创建研究话题 |
| `zn search <关键词>` | 搜索笔记 |
| `zn list` | 列出条目 |
| `zn remind <日期> <内容>` | 添加提醒 |
| `zn commit` | Git 提交 |

## 依赖

- [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code) CLI
- zsh shell

## 许可证

MIT

# Mojo Notes

AI-powered note-taking workflow system, driven by Claude Code.

[中文文档](README_CN.md)

## Quick Start

```bash
git clone https://github.com/xpzouying/mojo.git
cd mojo
./install.sh
source ~/.zshrc
```

## Usage

```bash
zn daily Today I learned about Kubernetes HPA
zn todo Submit quarterly report
zn note API design thoughts
zn research kubernetes-autoscaling
zn search kubernetes
zn list
zn remind +3d Review PR
zn commit
```

## What It Does

- Creates `~/mojo-notes/` with organized directories (daily/research/notes)
- Installs Claude Code skill for AI-powered note management
- Adds `zn` command for quick access from terminal

## Directory Structure

```
~/mojo-notes/
├── daily/           # Daily logs (YYYYMM.md)
├── research/        # Research topics
├── notes/           # Personal notes
└── REMINDER.md      # Reminders
```

## Requirements

- [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code) CLI installed
- zsh shell

## License
